title: US Treasury targets growth, imbalances at G20 finance meeting as digital asset sanctions expand
summary:
The US's expanded sanctions on digital assets at the G20 meeting could reshape global trade dynamics and intensify compliance challenges.
The post US Treasury targets growth, imbalances at G20 finance meeting as digital asset sanctions expand appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: At the recent G20 finance meeting, the US Treasury focused on economic growth and global imbalances while simultaneously expanding sanctions on digital assets. This regulatory shift aims to address financial security concerns. However, market participants warn that the broader enforcement measures could reshape international trade dynamics and create significant compliance challenges for digital asset platforms operating globally.

title: Anthropic Previews Standard for AI Control of Physical Devices
summary:
Anthropic is opening a research preview of a shared specification for artificial intelligence agents to operate physical devices, specifically lab and manufacturing instruments, the company said in a Thursday (Aug. 27) announcement. The Model Hardware Standard (MHS) enables agents to operate instruments such as microscopes, liquid handlers and robotic arms; perform tasks ranging from routine […]
The post Anthropic Previews Standard for AI Control of Physical Devices appeared first on PYMNTS.com.
content: Anthropic has launched a research preview for the Model Hardware Standard, a shared specification allowing artificial intelligence agents to operate physical equipment. The initiative targets tools like microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms, enabling AI systems to safely manage complex tasks in laboratory and manufacturing environments.
